source.title: Two-Phase Stefan Problems. Recent Results and Open Questions

trace.notes: Resolved zbMATH document 6127799 through the zbMATH API. The record identifies Sandro Salsa, Two-Phase Stefan Problems. Recent Results and Open Questions, Milan Journal of Mathematics 80, 267-281 (2012), DOI 10.1007/s00032-012-0180-0.
Crossref confirmed the exact DOI and title and exposed Springer PDF and HTML links for the version of record.
OpenAlex confirmed the same title and DOI but reported open_access.is_oa=false, no best open-access location, and no repository full text.

Failure mode: missing_or_invalid_artifact. The Springer HTML available through the article endpoint contains metadata, abstract, and a PDF preview/download wrapper rather than full article problem statements. The exact DOI PDF was downloaded, but local PDF text extraction/readability tools failed in the current sandbox, so the source could not be normalized to readable full text for evidence-grounded extraction. No questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, resolver records, or snippets.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6127799.json and outputs/latest.json.
